limits: This is the reusable service-preflight seam only. It does not add or execute a project command, sandbox launch, application process, SDK request, judgment, audit pack, or control-plane operation.
The application port and already-discovered SDK initialization are parent inputs. Phase 05 must bind them to the selected snapshot/entrypoint and exact compatible SDK tuple before launch.
Deterministic fixture readiness proves only that the package-owned listener accepts loopback connections; it deliberately does not consume one-shot fixture or model routes.
The Ollama branch was covered by current source tests and the separately bound live relay evidence; this preflight replay did not perform another inference.
The child overlay contains generated bearers until cleanup and is launch-only sensitive state. Persisted lifecycle and component receipts contain no bearer values.
Both accepted sandbox tuples remain rejected, so project-launch-dependent Phase 04 exit proof is not runnable and is not inferred from this component proof.
